market_data.long_business_summary: Prothena Corporation plc, a late-stage clinical biotechnology company, focuses on discovery and development of novel therapies to treat diseases caused by protein dysregulation. Its product pipeline includes Prasinezumab, an investigational humanized monoclonal antibody which is in Phase 3 clinical trial for the treatment of parkinson's disease and other synucleinopathies.
